micro-arcade.summary: A collection of small browser games, with quick starts and plenty of reasons to come back.
micro-arcade.caption: Breakout Mini, captured during a real run in Micro Arcade.
micro-arcade.note: Local play works on its own. Global leaderboards depend on the optional online service.

pdf-studio.summary: Edit, annotate and organize PDFs in your browser.
pdf-studio.caption: The built-in sample document open in the real PDF Studio workspace.
pdf-studio.note: Release candidate. Keep original documents and check exported files before relying on them.

manuscript.summary: Write in Markdown. Shape it into something worth reading.
manuscript.caption: Manuscript’s guided sample, with Markdown source beside the document preview.
manuscript.note: A developing publishing tool. Keep project backups and check pagination before final export.

wordstrike.summary: An arcade typing game where accuracy keeps you alive.
wordstrike.caption: A real Endless-mode run in WORDSTRIKE. A physical keyboard is required.
wordstrike.note: Designed for a desktop or laptop with a keyboard.

the-bible-challenge.summary: Explore the Bible through questions, collections and replayable challenges.
the-bible-challenge.caption: A real question inside The Bible Challenge.

mathlab.line: Work the problem. See the mathematics.
mathlab.summary: An interactive workspace for mathematical exploration and practice.
mathlab.caption: MathLab’s mathematical workspace. This project is in beta.

unreached.line: A map with a different question.
unreached.summary: Explore peoples, languages and access to Scripture in a world mission atlas.
unreached.caption: The Unreached world atlas. This project is in beta.
unreached.note: A developing visualization, not a definitive measure of an individual’s faith or access. Check the atlas’s data notes and limitations.

artikelwerk.summary: Deliberate German noun-gender practice, one decision at a time.
artikelwerk.caption: Artikelwerk’s German vocabulary practice interface.

voidcut.summary: A precision arcade game about cutting space and protecting moving nodes.
voidcut.caption: The VOIDCUT browser game.

tiny-tools.summary: Hundreds of browser tools for documents, images, audio, video, data, code, calculators and everyday tasks.
tiny-tools.caption: The Tiny Tools collection, with its full-toolbox search, categories and utility directory.
tiny-tools.note: Most tools process content locally. Network-dependent tools disclose their external connections. Format support varies by browser.
